decision: Supersede BLV2-DEC-007. UC-08 minimum commitment payment qualification policy is no longer undefined. Each governed offer declares its own minimum commitment payment/qualification threshold. A commitment becomes QUALIFIED DEMAND only when a valid commitment exists and cumulative confirmed settlement meets or exceeds that offer-specific threshold. Confirmed settlement below threshold remains real economic evidence but does not qualify pooled demand. Overpayment must be explicitly recorded and must not manufacture quantity. Reversals are additive canonical events and may remove qualification before irreversible downstream activity when net qualifying settlement falls below threshold; after irreversible activity the system creates a governed exception/receivable/remedy rather than rewriting history. This closes the policy question only; implementation, concurrency/idempotency, runtime and evidence gates remain independently required.
constraints: live Paystack mode remains separately governed
Production payment/refund/fulfillment mutation authority is not expanded by this decision

decision: Ratify the final membership-policy cleanup: approval establishes membership eligibility but not active membership rights; active rights require confirmed annual subscription settlement or a valid EMPLOYEE_SPONSORED_MEMBERSHIP entitlement. Employee sponsorship automatically renews annually while workforce standing remains ACTIVE; workforce cessation stops future sponsorship renewal but does not retroactively cancel the current sponsored period. A Primary Member may nominate up to two individually identified beneficiaries; beneficiaries pay no separate annual membership fee, beneficiary slots may not be commercially transferred, and replacement is subject to a versioned anti-abuse operational limit. Authentication never creates membership eligibility or rights.
